name: Furosemide
status: DRAFT – pharmacology (†) is not yet checked against the package insert; doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text
dagger_note: † = general pharmacology; not in the SA guideline and not yet checked against the package insert
item_format: t=text, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold, h=heading

moa.t: Inhibits the Na-K-2Cl co-transporter in the thick ascending limb, IV venodilation precedes diuresis

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Furosemide, oral, daily. · Initial dose: 40 mg/day. · Higher dosages may be needed, especially if comorbid renal failure.
Furosemide, IV, 40–80 mg. · Duration of action: 6 hours. · Potentiates all of the above medicines.
Furosemide, IV, 40 mg with delivery of the baby. · Monitor for 48 hours thereafter for pulmonary oedema.

Furosemide, oral or IV, 20 to 80 mg daily, as a single or divided doses, initiating at the lowest effective dose and titrating upwards. Dose may be increased to 160 mg daily (IV or oral) in divided doses.
Furosemide, oral or IV, 40 mg in divided doses (e.g., 8 AM and 2 PM). · Titrate to a maximum of 500 mg in divided doses (e.g., 8 AM and 2 PM).
Furosemide, oral, 40 mg twice a day in divided doses.
Furosemide, slow IV, 40 mg. · If response is adequate, follow with 40 mg in 2–4 hours. · If no response within 20–30 minutes: furosemide, IV, 80 mg.
Furosemide, oral, daily (doctor initiated). · Initial dose: 40 mg daily. · If dose >80 mg/day is required, change dose interval to 12 hourly.
Furosemide, IV, 1 mg/kg, over 5 minutes. See dosing table: Appendix IV. · Do not put up a drip or run in any IV fluids.
Furosemide, oral, 1–3 mg/kg as a single daily dose.
Furosemide, IV, 1 mg/kg at the start of the transfusion.

dosing.h: Congenital Heart Disease with Left to Right Shunt

items.t: Furosemide, IV, 1 mg/kg, 8 hourly. Monitor urinary output.

dosing.h: Heart Failure, Acute with Pulmonary Oedema

items.t: Furosemide, oral, 1–2 mg/kg/dose 12 hourly. Titrate dose against clinical response. Potassium supplements are necessary if furosemide is used without an aldosterone antagonist, i.e. spironolactone.
Furosemide, IV, 1–2 mg/kg as a bolus slowly over 5 minutes. · If oliguric, maximum dose: 5 mg/kg/dose. 4.35
Furosemide, oral, 0.5–1.5 mg/kg/dose 12–24 hourly. · Maximum dose: 6 mg/kg/day. · May cause hypokalaemia.

adjustments.t: Avoid unless pulmonary oedema or heart failure

cautions.t: Give IV slowly (no faster than 4 mg/minute)

adverse_effects.t: Hypokalaemia, hyponatraemia, hypomagnesaemia, hypovolaemia, hypotension, acute kidney injury, ototoxicity with rapid high-dose IV, hyperuricaemia

monitoring.t: Potassium, sodium, creatinine, urine output, weight
